description: This file contains functions and logic for platform-specific firmware image identification, validation, extraction, and upgrade procedures, primarily tailored for BCM53XX devices. It manages different firmware formats and devices, including NAND and SafeLoader images, and provides mechanisms for extracting partitions, verifying firmware integrity, and performing system upgrades.

methods.name: get_magic_long_at
methods.description: Reads a 4-byte magic number from a file at a specified byte offset.

methods.name: get_le_long_at
methods.description: Reads a little-endian 4-byte number from a file at a specified byte offset.

methods.name: platform_flash_type
methods.description: Determines the flash type (serial or nand) based on /proc/mtd contents.

methods.name: platform_expected_image
methods.description: Returns the expected firmware image filename for the current device model.

methods.name: platform_identify
methods.description: Identifies the firmware format and extracts device-specific information based on the firmware file magic number.

methods.name: platform_other_check_image
methods.description: Performs validation of a firmware image against device expectations, quality checks, and integrity.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Main entry point for checking the validity and compatibility of a firmware image.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_nand_trx
methods.description: Handles upgrading firmware from a TRX image stored in NAND devices, involving partition extraction and replacement.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_nand_seamaseal
methods.description: Performs upgrade process specifically for Seama-sealed NAND firmware images, extracting UBI partitions and flashing.

methods.name: platform_img_from_safeloader
methods.description: Extracts image partitions from a SafeLoader firmware file for flashing.

methods.name: platform_other_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade process for non-NAND devices, handling different firmware formats.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Dispatches firmware upgrade based on device model.
